createVm.title: Create a new VM
createVm.blankVmDesc: Creates a blank virtual machine in VirtualBox (no disk or OS yet) with default memory (2048 MB) and 1 CPU. You can add a disk, install an operating system, and change memory/CPUs afterwards on the Edit page.
createVm.name: Name
createVm.noTemplatesYet: No templates marked yet - mark an existing VM as a template below.
createVm.fromTemplateDesc: Clones the selected template into a new, fully independent VM (its own disk - the template itself is never modified).
createVm.manageTemplatesDesc: Mark an existing VM (ideally powered off) as a template others can be cloned from.
createVm.noVmsToMark: No VMs exist yet to mark as a template.
disks.title: Virtual media
disks.subtitle: Every disk, ISO, and floppy VirtualBox has registered on this host - including ones left behind after a VM only detached (rather than deleted) them. To attach a disk to a VM, use that VM's Edit → Storage tab; this page is for the host-wide inventory, detaching, and cleaning up orphans.
disks.missingTitle: Registered with VirtualBox, but no file exists at this path
disks.registerDesc: Adds a disk/ISO/floppy file VirtualBox doesn't know about yet to the list above (registers it without attaching it to any VM). Use a VM's Edit → Storage tab to actually attach it afterward.
disks.createNewDiskDesc: Creates a blank disk registered with VirtualBox but not attached to any VM yet - attach it from a VM's Storage tab.
disks.confirmRemoveMedium:
Remove this medium from VirtualBox's registry? The file itself is left on disk.

cloudInit.intro: Build NoCloud seed ISOs for unattended VM installs. Edit the cloud-config below (use {hostnameCode} as a placeholder - it's filled in per-build from meta-data's {localHostnameCode}), save it as a reusable template, then generate an ISO from it.
cloudInit.cloudConfigHelp: Standard #cloud-config YAML - same format as any cloud-init NoCloud seed.
cloudInit.metaDataHelp: No need to add {instanceIdCode} yourself - the app always generates a fresh one on build, even though it's not in the default above, so cloud-init reliably re-runs on the new ISO. Set {localHostnameCode} here - it's the single source of truth for hostname, also used to fill {hostnameCode} above.
cloudInit.networkConfigHelp: Standard cloud-init network-config YAML. Leave blank to omit - cloud-init falls back to its own default (typically DHCP on all interfaces).
cloudInit.isoNameHelp: Builds the seed ISO from everything above, written as {isoNameCode}.
cloudInit.confirmDeleteIso:
Delete the generated ISO "{name}" from disk?

This cannot be undone.
networks.subtitle: Host-wide networks any VM can attach to. To pick which network a specific VM's adapter uses, edit that VM's Network tab.
networks.confirmRemoveNat: Remove NAT network "{name}"? Any VM using it will lose connectivity until reconfigured.
networks.internalReadOnlyNote: named on a VM's NIC - read-only
networks.noInternal: No internal networks currently in use by any VM.
networks.confMissing: No {path} - only VirtualBox's built-in default range is allowed: {range} (and its IPv6 equivalent). An IP outside the allowed range fails with a misleading "permission denied". Create that file (each line: {ruleFormat}) to allow other subnets.
networks.confEmpty: {path} exists but has no rules - nothing outside VirtualBox's default range ({range}) is allowed.
networks.confFound: From {path} - an IP outside these ranges fails with a misleading "permission denied" when you try to set it below.
networks.confirmRemoveDhcp: Remove the DHCP server on "{name}"? Any VM using it will lose connectivity until reconfigured.
networks.setAutomaticHelp: No static IP - this adapter gets its address from a DHCP server already on that network (e.g. one you run yourself, not VirtualBox's).
networks.confirmRemoveHostOnly: Remove host-only interface "{name}"? Any VM using it will lose connectivity until reconfigured.
vmDetail.screenshotWhenRunning: Screenshot available when the VM is running.
vmDetail.confirmAcpiStop: Send ACPI shutdown to this VM?
vmDetail.confirmForceStop: Force stop (power off) this VM? Unsaved data in the guest will be lost.
vmDetail.confirmDeleteVm: Permanently DELETE this VM and its files from VirtualBox? This cannot be undone.
editVm.editSubtitle: Change VM settings. The VM should be powered off for changes to apply cleanly.
editVm.autostartHelp: Requires the host's autostart database to be configured ({code}) - saved separately from the rest of this form, so if it fails your other changes are unaffected.
editVm.autostartEnabled: Start this VM automatically on host boot
editVm.executionCapHelp: Limits CPU time given to the VM relative to the host.
editVm.usbFilterHelp: Hold/ignore action isn't shown here - VirtualBox doesn't expose it for reading back, only setting.
editVm.noNatAdapters: No adapters are set to NAT.
editVm.sharedFolderHelp: Read-only/auto-mount aren't shown here - VirtualBox doesn't expose them for reading back, only setting.
editVm.confirmRemoveController: Remove controller {name}? Its attachments will be detached first.
